text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, and the audience is abuzz with discussion of Mihono Bourbon's goal of winning the Triple Crown despite her talent for sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the same, Rice Shower cheers Mihono Bourbon on in the midst of all the criticism.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Mihono Bourbon enters the race intent on changing the public's opinion of her.
